:::{#exr-homogeneous-absolute-value}
#### Testing whether the absolute value is homogeneous

A [homogeneous function](#def-homogeneous-function) turns a rescaled input into the same rescaling of its output,
including a rescaling by a negative number.
Let $f: \reals \to \reals$ be the [absolute value](algebra.qmd#def-absolute-value),
$f(x) = \abs{x}$.

Is $f$ [homogeneous](#def-homogeneous-function)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Try a negative $c$ in @def-homogeneous-function.
